A clear journey

From your first detail to the final delivery.

A straightforward four-step booking journey, designed to make moving easier to organise.

01

Enter your details

Tell us where you are moving from and to, what items you need transported, and when.

02

Get an instant price

Our smart pricing engine calculates a fair price based on distance, items, and services needed.

03

Book and pay securely

Confirm your booking and pay by card through Stripe. FlyttGo pays the driver after the job is confirmed as done.

04

Track your delivery

Follow your driver in real time from pickup to delivery with live GPS tracking.

Choose the right capacity

The right van makes all the difference.

Explore four vehicle sizes, their carrying capacity and the kinds of moves each is suited to.

Small van

Capacity3–4 m³
Payload500–900 kg
Best for: small deliveries, student moves and luggage transport.
850 NOK / hour

Medium van

Capacity6–9 m³
Payload900–1,200 kg
Best for: studio moves, small apartment moves and furniture delivery.
1,150 NOK / hour

Large van

Capacity11–15 m³
Payload1,200–1,500 kg
Best for: 1–2 bedroom moves, large furniture and storage unit transport.
1,500 NOK / hour

Luton van

Capacity18–20 m³
Payload1,000–1,200 kg
Best for: 2–3 bedroom house moves, office relocation and heavy furniture.
1,900 NOK / hour

Hourly rates are on the van size guide. Your final price depends on the booking details and applicable pricing rules.

Trust and data boundaries

Shared infrastructure does not mean
shared private data.

FlyttGo's network model brings marketplace operators, service businesses, providers and customers into one connected service economy. Shared infrastructure should not mean shared ownership of every relationship or record.

FLYTTGO / NETWORK MODELCONCEPTUAL ARCHITECTURE
INDEPENDENT OPERATORSWhite-label marketplaces

Own brand, domain, customer proposition and commercial rules. Own provider networks: in development.

PLATFORM OPERATORFlyttGo marketplace

Central marketplace connecting customers with participating businesses and services.

SHARED PLATFORM SERVICES
COMMON INFRASTRUCTUREFlyttGo Platform

Marketplace engine · Business tools · Workflow configuration · Payments integration · Records and permissions

SHARED TECHNICAL FOUNDATION
CONTROLLED PARTICIPATION
SUPPLY SIDEBusinesses and providers

Service catalogues, teams, availability, work and business records.

DEMAND SIDECustomers and organisations

Discover services, request work, confirm terms and manage their engagements.

Marketplace ownership

An independent operator controls its marketplace identity, customer proposition, provider relationships and configured commercial rules. The platform supplies the underlying technology according to the agreed service model.

Conceptual platform architecture. The diagram describes the intended network model; it does not certify that multi-tenant isolation, delegated administration or all marketplace integrations are currently production-ready.
Distinct identitiesEach marketplace can present its own brand, domain, service proposition and customer experience.
Scoped relationshipsProviders participate under explicit terms, and access to customer relationships follows those terms.
Separated recordsMarketplace, business and customer records require clear ownership, access scopes and auditability.
Shared foundationsCommon infrastructure can support many operators without collapsing their separate businesses.
The architectural principle: shared infrastructure, separately governed tenants. A marketplace operator should not automatically see another operator's customers, providers, transactions or business records. Access must be explicitly scoped, authorised and auditable.
